integrity.finite_computation: Separate coefficient-system checks in 16 quiver cases over three prime fields; not a replacement for proof.
integrity.priority: Genuine partial coverage by 2012 torsion-free antiderivation theory explicitly acknowledged.
integrity.proof: Complete field-independent Peirce normalization and arrow-loop fiber classification, with characteristic-two central-component correction.

scientific_limitations: Finite quivers and k-linear maps on radical-square-zero quotients only; not full path algebras or generalized quiver relations.
The two-block torsion-free antiderivation mechanism and acyclic special cases are known; the novelty concerns the complete all-quiver defect dimension and characteristic-two loop terms.
Absolute literature priority and independent validation remain outstanding.
title: Characteristic-two loop and reversal defects of Jordan derivations on radical-square-zero quiver algebras
